plugins.name: databrief
plugins.description: Turn a data file (CSV, Excel, Parquet, SQLite, SQL or PostgreSQL dump, JSON, PDF, Word and more) into a prompt that describes it, with or without the data in it. Shows the DataBrief page in the chat, or reads a file with the bundled offline tool.
